name: Farmer
description: Works soil that belongs to someone else. Paid in what is left.
hint: Someone has to work the ground.

name: Hunter
description: Reads droppings the way a clerk reads ledgers. Sells the hide before the meat.
hint: Someone goes after the beasts.

name: Carpenter
description: Measures twice, charges once, and blames the timber.
hint: Someone puts the trees to use.

name: Blacksmith
description: Burned forearms and a short temper. The guild sets the price and the smith pays it.
hint: Someone tends the forge.

name: Herbalist
description: Knows which leaf mends and which one ends. Keeps both on the same shelf.
hint: Someone gathers what grows low and wet.

name: Merchant
description: Buys cheap, sells blessed. Every scale in the stall is honest on inspection day.
hint: Someone follows the silver.

name: Scribe
description: Ink to the wrist and a stamp for everything. Nothing happened until a scribe wrote it down.
hint: Someone holds the quill.

name: Soldier
description: Fed, armed, and pointed. The pay arrives later than the orders.
hint: Someone is handed iron.

name: Spy
description: Nobody's cousin, everybody's drinking friend. Paid twice for the same secret.
hint: Someone works in the dark.

name: Tea Shop Owner
description: Keeps the kettle on and the gossip warm. The one door on the row that nobody slams.
hint: A merchant finds something worth steeping.

name: Wizard
description: Licensed, stamped, and watched. Reads what others are fined for owning.
hint: Someone opens the book.

name: Alchemist
description: Stained fingers and a cough. Turns weeds into medicine and, on bad days, the reverse.
hint: A gatherer learns to change what they gather.

name: Runesmith
description: Cuts words into hot iron and hopes they hold. The ones that fail are sold as scrap.
hint: A smith learns to write.

name: Enchanter
description: Binds a working into a thing and sells the thing. The price covers the blisters.
hint: A wizard learns to set a working in stone.

name: Battle Mage
description: Marches with the column and burns what it is pointed at. The only casting the army never fines.
hint: A soldier is taught to burn.

name: Court Mage
description: Stands a step behind the chair. One wrong word near the wrong ear and it is heresy.
hint: A wizard comes near the crown.

name: Hermit Wizard
description: Went into the trees with a book and did not come back for the census.
hint: A wizard walks into the wilds.

name: Necromancer
description: Works nights, pays in coin, keeps no neighbors. The church has a form for people like this.
hint: A wizard looks past the line between living and dead.

name: Healer
description: Sets bones, breaks fevers, and keeps a writ nailed where the inspector can see it. Paid in eggs as often as coin.
hint: A gatherer learns a mending spell.

name: Magical Scholar
description: Has read every working and cast almost none. Can cite the statute that forbids each one.
hint: A scribe starts reading what they copy.

name: Professor
description: Teaches what the church allows and hints at the rest. The students pay, and the faculty owe.
hint: A scholar is given someone to teach.

name: Back-Room Apothecary
description: No sign, no ledger, no questions. Sells what the licensed shops are fined for stocking, and a little they have never heard of.
hint: An alchemist stops filing the paperwork.
